title: Fix blank page crash after deployment

requirements.summary: Diagnose and fix the blank page issue by auditing App.tsx for runtime errors, missing null guards on authentication state, and role-based routing logic. Ensure the app renders a visible UI for all authentication states.
acceptanceCriteria: The app loads and displays the login page or dashboard without going blank after a fresh deployment
No unhandled JavaScript exceptions are thrown during initial render
All role-based routes (admin, staff, delivery, distributor) render without blank screens
Unauthenticated users see the login page instead of a blank screen
The app recovers gracefully if backend actor initialization is slow or fails

file_operations.description: Add defensive null guards on all authentication state accesses (user, token, role checks). Ensure role-based routing logic explicitly handles undefined/null user states with fallback to LoginPage. Add loading states for actor initialization. Verify that the component returns valid JSX in all code paths (authenticated, unauthenticated, loading, error). Replace any implicit undefined returns with explicit loading or fallback UI.

Add defensive checks to prevent AuthContext from returning undefined user/token values that could cause downstream blank renders. Ensure sessionStorage access is wrapped in try-catch to handle corrupted or missing session data gracefully. Add a loading state to AuthContext that components can check before attempting to render role-dependent content.

Add null guards for authentication hooks and ensure the component renders a visible login form even if Internet Identity or actor is initializing. Prevent blank renders during authentication state transitions.
Add defensive null checks on query results and authentication state. Ensure the component displays loading skeletons or fallback UI instead of returning undefined when data is pending or missing.
Add null guards on orders query and authentication state. Ensure the component returns valid JSX in all states (loading, error, empty data).
Add null guards on stores query and authentication state. Ensure the component returns valid JSX in all states.
Add null guards on users query and authentication state. Ensure the component returns valid JSX in all states.
Add null guards on orders and stores queries. Ensure the component returns valid JSX in all states.

Add null guards on deliveries query and authentication state. Ensure the component returns valid JSX in all states.

requirements.summary: Add a top-level error boundary component wrapping the entire React application in App.tsx to catch and display any unhandled render errors with a user-friendly fallback UI instead of a blank page.
acceptanceCriteria: A React ErrorBoundary component wraps the top-level app content
When a render error is caught, a fallback UI is displayed instead of a blank page
The fallback UI includes a reload/retry button
The error boundary does not interfere with normal app rendering

file_operations.description: Create a React class-based ErrorBoundary component with componentDidCatch lifecycle method to capture render errors. Implement a fallback UI that displays the app name 'Vitalist Water — Order & Delivery Management', an error message stating 'An unexpected error occurred', and a reload button that calls window.location.reload(). Include error logging to console for debugging. Export the component as default.

Import the ErrorBoundary component and wrap the entire app content (role-based routing and layout components) inside <ErrorBoundary>. Ensure the ErrorBoundary is placed immediately inside the root component return statement, above all authentication and routing logic.

requirements.summary: Audit all lazy-loaded or dynamically imported components (maps, Leaflet, QR scanner, camera) for missing Suspense boundaries or import failures that could cause a blank render. Wrap all such components with React.Suspense and appropriate loading fallbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: All dynamically imported components (SatelliteMapView, QRScanModal, BarcodeScanStep) have Suspense boundaries with loading indicators
A failure to load a dynamic component does not blank out the entire page
Loading states are visible while async components initialize

file_operations.description: Audit the Leaflet CDN loading logic. Ensure the component returns valid JSX (a loading spinner or skeleton) while Leaflet scripts are being loaded. Add error handling for failed CDN loads and display a fallback message instead of causing a blank render. Verify the component never returns undefined or null without a fallback UI.

Verify the component uses camera/useCamera correctly. Ensure camera hook initialization errors are caught and displayed in the UI instead of causing a blank page. Add explicit loading states while the camera is initializing. Verify the component returns valid JSX in all states (supported, not-supported, error, loading).

Verify the component uses qr-code/useQRScanner correctly. Ensure QR scanner hook errors and initialization states are properly handled with visible fallback UI. Add explicit loading states while jsQR library is loading. Verify the component returns valid JSX in all states.

Wrap the SatelliteMapView component usage with React.Suspense and provide a loading fallback (e.g., a spinner or 'Loading map...' message). Ensure query error states display a fallback UI instead of causing a blank render.
